snippet.title: Jewel of Seven Stars (longplay) for the TI-99/4A
snippet.description:
Came also out for:

---


Game description:

Jewel of Seven Stars is a homebrew game where the player plays as John Benning, an archeologist and tomb raider. He collects treasures, escapes mummies (although he can also light them with a torch but that can also backfire!), jumps over flying snakes, collects more treasure and hopefully find the titular Jewel of Seven Stars.
There are 17 levels in total, not counting the bonus levels in-between.
